test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Stevie loved a good mystery novel.

options.text: A good mystery novel was being loved by Stevie.
A good mystery novel was loved by Stevie.
A good mystery novel had been loved by Stevie.
A good mystery novel is loved by Stevie.

solution:
The correct answer is '**A good mystery novel was loved by Stevie.​'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Stevie'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'A good mystery'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'loved' will be changed into 'was loved'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *A good mystery novel was loved by Stevie.*

72:T
